correctness.rationale: A necessary and sufficient commutation criterion for each interval clamp permits a fully specified weighted binary-word sum. Three endpoint cases yield the closed polynomial for every \(n\ge1\) and both boundary choices. Its \(z^0\) and \(z^2\) coefficients recover the interior length and product of exterior gaps. Summing those polynomials proves the rational joint series and its aggregate factorization. A unique dominant double pole near \(z=1\) yields the centered Gaussian conditional image-rank law. Direct exhaustive composition checks through n=11 and algebraic reconstruction checks through n=35 corroborate, but do not replace, the all-n proofs.

value.rationale: The rank-weighted idempotent centralizer is a natural intrinsic transformation-semigroup invariant whose two low-degree coefficients determine nonconstant clamp geometry up to the unavoidable reversal; unweighted cardinalities fail to make even some basic distinctions (n=4 centralizers both size eight). The complete rational rank census of all commuting idempotent–arbitrary pairs and its conditioned Gaussian rank law give further structural and asymptotic consequences. These outputs are not arbitrary parameter slices or routine recomputations of known scalar totals.
